FormulaDefinition:
If(
    Not(IsBlank(az_keyvaultreference_parent)),
    If(
        IsBlank(az_keyvaultreference_parent.az_templatevaultname),
        Blank(),
        "https://" & az_keyvaultreference_parent.az_templatevaultname & ".vault.azure.net/"
    ),
    Not(IsBlank(az_keyvaultreference_parentcomponent)),
    az_keyvaultreference_parentcomponent.keyvaulturi,
    If(
        IsBlank(az_templatevaultname),
        Blank(),
        "https://" & az_templatevaultname & ".vault.azure.net/"
    )
)
